description: Correct BRDF, split-sum environment integration and Khronos clearcoat layering. Adds the generated brdf-probe fixture, CPU reference lanes for the DFG LUT/prefilter/solid-angle irradiance, and numeric GPU readback in Studio, Clay and Directional plus Car/Camera nonregression captures in all three modes.

knownDefects.description: Physical transmission still uses the alpha-carried interface Fresnel and no transmitted-scene sampling. Diagnostic channel 22 exposes (alpha, glassReflectance, transmission); T26/T27 own the real path.
knownDefects.label: limitation

knownDefects.description: The independent uniform-quadrature prefilter/LUT reference is finite-sampled at low roughness; production importance sampling covers that range and the white-furnace identity is checked separately.
knownDefects.label: limitation
